hook.on-activate:
FLOX_ZSH="$FLOX_ENV/bin/zsh"
  TARGET_ZSH="/usr/local/bin/zsh"
 
  if [[ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]]; then
    CURRENT_SHELL="$(dscl . -read "/Users/$USER" UserShell 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')"
  else
    CURRENT_SHELL="$(getent passwd "$USER" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f7)"
  fi

  if [ "$CURRENT_SHELL" != "$TARGET_ZSH" ]; then
    echo "CURRENT_SHELL:'$CURRENT_SHELL'; TARGET:'$TARGET_ZSH'; FLOX:'$FLOX_ZSH'"
    # Create a symlink to the FLOX's zsh binary in the environment if it doesn't already exist or points to a different location
    if [ "$(readlink "$TARGET_ZSH")" != "$FLOX_ZSH" ]; then
      if ln -sF "$FLOX_ZSH" "$TARGET_ZSH" 2>/dev/null || \
        sudo ln -sF "$FLOX_ZSH" "$TARGET_ZSH" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "'$TARGET_ZSH' symlinked to '$FLOX_ZSH' ✔"
      else
        echo "Creating symlink '$TARGET_ZSH → $FLOX_ZSH' failed. Please try manually."
      fi
    fi

    if ! grep -qxF "$TARGET_ZSH" /etc/shells 2>/dev/null; then
      if echo "$TARGET_ZSH" | tee -a /etc/shells >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          echo "$TARGET_ZSH" | sudo tee -a /etc/shells >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "'$TARGET_ZSH' added to /etc/shells ✔"
      else
        echo "Could not add '$TARGET_ZSH' to /etc/shells. Please try manually."
      fi
    fi

    # Change the user's login shell to the FLOX's zsh
    if chsh -s "$TARGET_ZSH" "$USER" 2>/dev/null || \
      usermod -s "$TARGET_ZSH" "$USER" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s|^\($USER:.*:\)[^:]*$|\1$TARGET_ZSH|" /etc/passwd; then
          echo "'$TARGET_ZSH' set as the login shell for '$USER' ✔"
    else
      echo "Could not set login shell for '$USER'. Please try manually."
    fi
  fi

profile.zsh:
is_devcontainer() { [ -n "${REMOTE_CONTAINERS:-}" ] || [ -n "${CODESPACES:-}" ] || [ -f "/.devcontainer/.postCreateCommandMarker" ] || [ -d "/.devcontainer" ]; }
  if is_devcontainer && [ -f "$FLOX_ENV/bin/mise" ]; then
    eval "$($FLOX_ENV/bin/mise activate zsh --shims)"
  fi

hook.on-activate:
FLOX_ZSH="$FLOX_ENV/bin/zsh"
  TARGET_ZSH="/usr/local/bin/zsh"
 
  if [[ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]]; then
    CURRENT_SHELL="$(dscl . -read "/Users/$USER" UserShell 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')"
  else
    CURRENT_SHELL="$(getent passwd "$USER" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f7)"
  fi

  if [ "$CURRENT_SHELL" != "$TARGET_ZSH" ]; then
    echo "CURRENT_SHELL:'$CURRENT_SHELL'; TARGET:'$TARGET_ZSH'; FLOX:'$FLOX_ZSH'"
    # Create a symlink to the FLOX's zsh binary in the environment if it doesn't already exist or points to a different location
    if [ "$(readlink "$TARGET_ZSH")" != "$FLOX_ZSH" ]; then
      if ln -sF "$FLOX_ZSH" "$TARGET_ZSH" 2>/dev/null || \
        sudo ln -sF "$FLOX_ZSH" "$TARGET_ZSH" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "'$TARGET_ZSH' symlinked to '$FLOX_ZSH' ✔"
      else
        echo "Creating symlink '$TARGET_ZSH → $FLOX_ZSH' failed. Please try manually."
      fi
    fi

    if ! grep -qxF "$TARGET_ZSH" /etc/shells 2>/dev/null; then
      if echo "$TARGET_ZSH" | tee -a /etc/shells >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          echo "$TARGET_ZSH" | sudo tee -a /etc/shells >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "'$TARGET_ZSH' added to /etc/shells ✔"
      else
        echo "Could not add '$TARGET_ZSH' to /etc/shells. Please try manually."
      fi
    fi

    # Change the user's login shell to the FLOX's zsh
    if chsh -s "$TARGET_ZSH" "$USER" 2>/dev/null || \
      usermod -s "$TARGET_ZSH" "$USER" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s|^\($USER:.*:\)[^:]*$|\1$TARGET_ZSH|" /etc/passwd; then
          echo "'$TARGET_ZSH' set as the login shell for '$USER' ✔"
    else
      echo "Could not set login shell for '$USER'. Please try manually."
    fi
  fi

profile.zsh:
is_devcontainer() { [ -n "${REMOTE_CONTAINERS:-}" ] || [ -n "${CODESPACES:-}" ] || [ -f "/.devcontainer/.postCreateCommandMarker" ] || [ -d "/.devcontainer" ]; }
  if is_devcontainer && [ -f "$FLOX_ENV/bin/mise" ]; then
    eval "$($FLOX_ENV/bin/mise activate zsh --shims)"
  fi
